title: Mass Destruction: Otousan ni mo Dekiru Soft
native_title: マス・デストラクション ～お父さんにもできるソフト～
overview:
Destroy everything!

Fierce battle scenes in a virtual space drawn in fine detail with 3D polygons!

Mass Destruction is an overhead tank action game for one player. Pick one of three tanks - Cheetah, Cobra or Viper - trading speed against armor, and roll through towns, deserts, coastlines and snowfields on mission after mission. Each mission has a main target to destroy while you fight off or avoid enemy forces, plus optional objectives that earn bonus points toward extra missions. The turret turns independently, so you can drive one way and fire another, switching between weapons with limited ammunition. Progress is kept with memory backup.

すべてを破壊せよ！

3Dポリゴンで綿密に描かれた仮想空間での壮絶な戦闘シーン！
